title: 第16章 绝境的生路第17章 哥布林的草药包
content_zh:
“这些家伙怎么这么多？”凯斯大喊道。
“他们就是在周围采药的哥布林。”柯林狼狈地喘了几口气喊道：“我们太倒霉了！”
呼！
又是一箭从耳边飞过。
柯林浑身都起了鸡皮疙瘩。
哥布林腿短手短，单论跑步的话肯定是比不过他们的，但在粗糙的岩石地面上就反过来了。
想都不用想。
无论是他这个大半辈子都在城市里打拼的人类，还是凯斯这个常年在雪地里挣扎的半兽人，两者肯定都跑不过生于斯长于斯的哥布林，被追上只是时间问题。
这群哥布林会放过他们吗？
当然不会，柯林回忆着原身的记忆。
这世界的哥布林和他看过的影视作品很像。
他们就是群畸形的邪恶生物，对于他们而言，没什么事是比折磨其他生物更让他们愉快的了。
刚刚凯斯先下手为强绝对是明智之举，因为就算两人平心静气地和哥布林谈判，最后的结果肯定也是被折磨到死后变成他们的盘中餐。
就在思考之际。
柯林感觉肩头忽然传来一阵冲击，就像是被人狠狠打了一拳似的。
我中箭了？
回头一看。
插在肩膀上的箭杆正随着他的动作上下晃动。
一直过去两秒钟，剧痛才姗姗来迟，就好像被一把烧红的短刀捅了一下似的。
“躲开！”

凯斯的怒喝从身边传来。
柯林赶紧向旁跳开，对方拿起斧子向后一挥，将追上来、打算偷袭柯林的哥布林打飞出去。
“别被他们缠住了！”
在大喊的同时，柯林用伤手抱住袋子和草药，另一只手抽出武器。
他看向又一个追上来的哥布林，刺出武器。
这哥布林来不及停下脚步，粗糙的兽人短剑毫无阻碍地刺进他的咽喉，伤口处顿时血如泉涌。
柯林抽出短剑并转身迈步，将受到重创的敌人扔在身后。
“老弟，你没事吧？！”
“希望解毒剂有效，要不然就完蛋了。”柯林咬着牙答道。
他能听见自己的声音正在不断颤抖着。
话音刚落，五个哥布林不知道从哪个犄角旮旯窜到两人面前，挡住了逃生的去路。
这几个哥布林身上穿着的皮革明显更加厚实，身上也有不少兽牙和骨头装饰，这些家伙明显比后面那些地位更高。
身后传来一阵脚步声，后面的哥布林也都围了上来。
这群家伙倒是没有射箭了，不过发黑的矛尖已经近在咫尺，周围到处都是哥布林叽里咕噜的交谈声。
content_en:
"Why are there so many of these guys?" Case yelled.
"They are the Goblins who are gathering herbs around." Colin took a few breaths and shouted, "We are so unlucky!"
Phew!
Another arrow flew past his ear.
Colin had goosebumps all over his body.
Goblins have short legs and short hands, so they are definitely unable to outrun them when it comes to running, but the reverse is true on rough rocky ground.
No need to think about it.
Whether he was a human who had spent most of his life working hard in the city, or Keith, an orc who struggled in the snow all year round, neither of them could outrun the goblins who were born and raised here. It was only a matter of time before they caught up.
Will these goblins let them go?
Of course not, Colin recalled the memory of the original person.
The goblins in this world are very similar to the movies and TV shows he has seen.
They are a group of deformed evil creatures, and for them, nothing is more pleasurable than torturing other creatures.
It was definitely a wise move for Keith to strike first just now, because even if the two of them negotiated with the goblins calmly, the final result would definitely be that they would be tortured until they died and become their meal.
Just thinking about it.
Colin felt a sudden impact on his shoulder, as if he had been punched hard.
Did I get hit by an arrow?
Look back.
The arrow shaft stuck on his shoulder was swinging up and down with his movements.
Two seconds passed before the severe pain came belatedly, as if he had been stabbed by a red-hot dagger.
"Get away!"
Case's angry shout came from beside him.
Colin quickly jumped away, and the opponent picked up the ax and swung it back, knocking away the Goblin who was chasing Colin and planning to attack Colin.
"Don't get caught up in them!"
While shouting, Colin held the bag and herbs with his injured hand and drew his weapon with his other hand.
He looked at another goblin chasing after him and drew his weapon.
Before the goblin could stop in time, the rough orc dagger penetrated his throat without any hindrance, and blood suddenly gushed out from the wound.
Colin drew his short sword and turned around, leaving the heavily wounded enemy behind.
"Brother, are you okay?!"
"I hope the antidote is effective, otherwise it will be over." Colin gritted his teeth and replied.
He could hear his voice trembling.
As soon as he finished speaking, five goblins rushed in front of the two of them from nowhere, blocking the way to escape.
The leather worn by these goblins is obviously thicker, and they are also decorated with many animal teeth and bones. These guys are obviously of higher status than those behind them.
There was a sound of footsteps behind him, and the goblins behind him also gathered around.
This group of guys didn't shoot arrows anymore, but the blackened spear tips were already close at hand, and the goblins were chattering everywhere.
